purpose: Define and adversarially rehearse the concurrent nonce-allocation, crash, retry, rollback, failover, key-rotation, and exhaustion boundary required before Mythical may rely on A-053 cryptographic-misuse evidence in a multi-worker runtime. The control consumes current A-053 output and contract digests, launches sixteen real simultaneous allocator processes against one exclusive-create nonce namespace, requires sixteen unique winners, completes authenticated AES-256-GCM round trips only after durable allocation, and launches eight real retry claimants for one request with exactly one commit winner. It burns rather than reuses nonces reserved before crash, cancellation, or global disable; advances the counter after failover; rejects a rollback snapshot behind an independent high-watermark anchor; quarantines corrupt ledger state; separates key-version namespaces; detects a cross-region duplicate before encryption; refuses counter exhaustion and stale fencing; and rechecks global disable immediately before encryption. Every decision is payload-free and digest-bound. Temporary keys, allocations, ledgers, anchors, request claims, ciphertexts, mutations, and quarantine evidence are removed. The rehearsal configures no production provider, account, identity, key, nonce service, consensus store, region, objective, alert route, network, restore, admission, scheduler, dispatch, spend, or external action and grants no eligible-cycle credit.

Separate expiring approval admits exact providers, identities, keys, algorithms, nonce namespace, counter, anchor, fencing, retry, recovery, disable, kill and alert policies
